vendors.name: Artemex Papel Picado
vendors.price_text: Own site, read Oct 2026 (prices shown with $, currency not stated, MXN assumed): tissue (papel china) 'Boda blanco' pack of 10 strips, each 5.5 m (55 m), $240; other tissue 10-strip packs $254 to $254.40; plastic 10-strip pack of 5 m strips (50 m) $315 (Guadalupano multi), plastic 10-strip pack $351.75 (Viva la Virgen, strip length not shown); plastic 'tiliches' 10 strips of 6 m $403 (multicolor) or $399 (white-purple). Bodas.com.mx lists 'precio desde $540' for its decoration service (kit of 10 strips x 5 m = 50 m), 50% deposit on confirming and 50% before shipping, shipping extra. A Mercado Libre snippet showed a plastic 10 x 5 m pack at $284.99.
vendors.serves: Ships by courier to all Mexico and abroad (shipping extra). Workshop (Cuarta privada 12 de Octubre, Barrio San Antonio) and main shop (Av. 16 de Septiembre Norte 406) in San Salvador Huixcolotla, plus a branch in Puebla city (2 Oriente esq. 4 Norte, Local D, Centro Histórico). Also sells on Mercado Libre and Amazon Mexico.
vendors.contact: WhatsApp +52 221 585 1980 (second WhatsApp link +52 249 156 8707); phone +52 249 425 1397 (online sales), workshop +52 249 212 7279, Puebla branch (222) 227 6202; email agente.ventas@artemexpapelpicado.com; Instagram @papelpicadoartemex (34.2K followers, verified); Facebook ArtemexPpicado
vendors.notes: The best-documented maker found: family firm of Nuvia Reynoso, 25+ years, gives work to 30+ artisan families, ships worldwide. Bodas.com.mx says colour, text, shapes and images can be customised (a review mentions custom white and blue paper) and photo captions show 'Personalizado plástico', but the site's custom page only describes logo/brand projects with no colours, lead time or minimum, and its plastic strips shown are stock multicolor, white and themed. Ask for plastic in the six-colour palette plus a written minimum and lead time; Bodas asks for contact 15 days before the event, and the reviews shown there date from 2018 to 2020.

vendors.name: Papel Picado Mexicano (papelpicado.mx)
vendors.price_text: No prices on the site; ordering and prices are on its Etsy listing 'Personalized garland papel picado' (Etsy returns 403, so not read). The site says payments run through Conekta and prices show in the selected currency including taxes.
vendors.serves: Ships from Puebla to all Mexico (up to 5 days), the United States and Canada (7 to 10 days) with tracked, protected packaging; sells through Etsy.
vendors.contact: Email hola@papelpicado.mx; orders via the Etsy listing linked from the site (no WhatsApp, phone or address shown)
vendors.notes: Site says artisans from San Salvador Huixcolotla hand-cut up to 50 sheets of papel china at a time, with colours 'vibrantes, metálicas o tonos pastel', names, dates, phrases or vector logos, a digital sketch to approve before cutting, and 'opciones plásticas para exterior'. It claims 2 to 3 business days' production (its own steps say 5 business days in all), which looks optimistic for custom cutting; no minimum shown, and no cancellations or returns once cutting starts (24-hour window before production).

vendors.name: Papel Picado La Katrina
vendors.price_text: Bodas.com.mx: 'precio desde $1,000'; FAQ range $1,000 to $3,000 for decoration services. Wedding package: 50 personalised pieces of papel picado of 5 m each (250 m). Payment by OXXO, bank transfer, bank deposit or PayPal.
vendors.serves: Workshop at 16 de Septiembre #112, San Salvador Huixcolotla; lists 'envío de producto' (shipping scope not stated); does not travel to other zones or states (travel costs extra).
vendors.notes: Says it can make 'los colores más osados', shapes and messages, with 25+ years in event decoration; lead time 15 days for personalised models and 7 days for standard ones. Material (tissue vs plastic), names/dates and minimum order are not stated, and contact is only through the Bodas.com.mx form.

vendors.price_text: Bodas.com.mx: 'precio desde $180'; FAQ range $180 to $480 for decoration services. 50% deposit to book; bank transfer, Mercado Pago or deposit.
vendors.serves: Workshop at Allende 212, San Salvador Huixcolotla with a showroom; can travel to other areas or states for an extra travel cost; delivers the material.
vendors.notes: Fully handmade papel picado made 'según los gustos y exigencias' of the client (wedding motif or custom design, centerpiece banners, cocktail banners, table runners), 15+ years. Orders need 10 business days after the 50% deposit; custom colours, plastic, sizes and minimum order are not stated and contact is only through the Bodas.com.mx form.

vendors.serves: Workshop in Col. La Candelaria, San Salvador Huixcolotla (Bodas lists Luis Donaldo Colosio 718; the Cosmos directory lists Ignacio López Rayón 5); production 5 business days plus 3 to 4 business days shipping; travels to other states with the client paying travel costs; Cosmos lists nationwide coverage.
vendors.notes: Bodas.com.mx describes 'artesanías en papel y plástico' personalised with names, an image or a phrase, with an 'extensa variedad de colores y diseños', and recommends ordering about a month ahead. Its own website (papelpicadoalamexicana.com, listed on Cosmos) did not resolve and the two directories give different addresses, so confirm it is still operating before relying on it.

vendors.notes: Handmade papel picado in papel china, metallic paper and plastic, cut with hammer and chisels, 10 years' experience; lead time 10 business days for personalised work and 2 days for catalogue items. Reviews are mixed (2.2/5 in 2022 for wrong paper and no replies, 4.0 to 4.8 in 2017 to 2019), so ask for a colour proof and keep the colour spec in writing.

Plastic vs tissue is not stated; Instagram highlights show 'Personalizados' and 'Nombres cumple'.

vendors.name: Papel Picado Xochimilco (listed on Bodas.com.mx as Artesanías de Papel)
vendors.price_text: Bodas.com.mx listing 'Artesanías de Papel' (same address, Ciclamen 80, Xaltocan; https://www.bodas.com.mx/decoracion-para-bodas/artesanias-de-papel--e285689): 'precio desde $400'; FAQ range $400 to $4,000 for decoration services; payment in cash, card, transfer or OXXO deposit; home delivery costs extra. vendors.notes: Family workshop of Yuridia Torres Alfaro (second generation, 30 years' experience per Bodas) making papel picado on paper, plastic, cloth and card; Chilango says custom designs include couples' names and the client chooses the paper colours, with 3 to 8 days' notice (2022), while Bodas asks 3, 5, 8 or 12 business days depending on the work. AP (Oct 2022) says she still cuts tissue by hand and that many Mexicans now prefer plastic for sun and rain; the Cosmos directory lists 'Artesanías de Papel Picado' at Ciclamen 8, Xaltocan (website unreachable), probably the same business.

vendors.name: Pedro Ortega Lozano
vendors.serves: Studio at Av. Tláhuac 8041B, Barrio de la Asunción, Tláhuac, Mexico City; shipping and custom orders not stated.
vendors.notes: Master papel picado artist working in tissue, metallic and embossed papers; mexican-folk-art-guide.com says he was born in 1960 and has national folk-art recognition. The Feria Maestros profile says nothing about commissions, colours or prices, so treat him as a lead for premium bespoke pieces, not a stock supplier.

vendors.name: El Mexicano - Artesanías en Papel Picado
vendors.price_text: Bodas.com.mx: 'precio desde $460'; FAQ range $460 to $10,000 for papel picado production plus installation; 50% deposit and 50% on delivery of the personalised material; the client pays shipping.
vendors.serves: Zapopan (El Colli; Bodas gives the street as 'Volcan Ajuscc 1884') in the Guadalajara metro with a showroom; ships anywhere in Mexico (client pays) and can travel to other zones or states.

Plastic vs tissue and minimum order are not stated; all four reviews date from 2017 to 2019, so confirm it is still active (the vendor page shows 4.7, category cards show 4.6).

vendors.name: ArtMexico
vendors.price_text: No 'precio desde' or FAQ on the Bodas.com.mx listing. Custom orders take about 4 weeks and ship free worldwide by DHL with tracking and insurance; non-custom garlands ship immediately from stock.
vendors.serves: Guadalajara base (Mar Egeo 1452, 44610); custom garlands are made to order in Mexico and shipped worldwide; ready-made garlands ship from stock held in Aylesbury (UK) and Nevada (USA).
vendors.notes: Handmade papel picado garlands from tissue paper or 'banderines de plástico impermeable' (waterproof plastic banners), with the couple's names and wedding date; a photo caption reads 'Bunting in your colour palette' but gives no colour details. Founder Aprylle Stuart (British, 14 years in Mexico) is 'available throughout the ordering process'; no price, minimum or direct contact is shown, and its own domain (artmexico.co.uk) rate-limited every fetch.

vendors.name: Jesús Morales Torres

vendors.name: Taquizas MX / Taquizas en Querétaro (Grupo Bonanza Grill)
vendors.price_text: Home-page table, per person (p/p), all from 30 guests: tacos de pastor with live trompo $170; mini trompos de pastor $220 (30 to 200 guests); taquiza tradicional (pastor, suadero, bistec, chorizo) $190; trompo gourmet $350; trompo gourmet plus taquiza $320; carne asada $350; alambres $240; corn tortillas made to order on the guisados option +$25 p/p. Includes napkins, eco plates, salt shakers, uniformed taquero and clean setup; service lasts 1 h 30 min or 2 h. The page's own FAQ also cites $120 to $180 p/p for 50 guests, which does not match the table. Same-group site taquizas.vip shows 'desde $170' (pastor) to 'desde $350' (trompos gourmet) with no unit.

vendors.notes: Brings a live trompo to the venue ('Llevamos el trompo directamente a tu jardín o salón') with its own gas/heat; needs a flat space and arrives 60 min early. Minimum 30 guests (fits 60 to 70), service 1.5 to 2 h (wedding page says generally 3 h); pastor, arrachera (trompo gourmet) and pollo (pechuga adobada, alambres) are all listed; travel outside Querétaro city 'may vary' but no fee shown. vendors.name: Q,taco (Taquizas para Eventos)
vendors.price_text: No prices shown (the 'Menú / Lista de precios' section has no figures); quotes by WhatsApp. Included: hot plancha and full equipment, uniformed taqueros, hot tortillas, homemade salsas, setup and cleanup, e-invoicing.
vendors.serves: Querétaro (no service radius shown; a past event in Ezequiel Montes, Querétaro is pictured)
vendors.notes: Sets up and carves a trompo al pastor on site ('Montamos el trompo en sitio y cortamos al momento'); also a trompo gourmet (picaña, sirloin, arrachera) and a five-meat plancha taquiza; pollo not listed. Minimum 30 people or equivalent minimum spend, book at least 1 week ahead, claims 10+ years; no hours included or travel policy shown.

vendors.name: Taquizas Para Fiestas y Eventos
vendors.price_text: Bodas.com.mx listing: 'Precio desde $125'; FAQ says wedding menus cost 'desde $125 hasta $300' per guest, for 100 to 300 guests. 50% deposit up front, balance on the event day (deposit, transfer or cash).

Minimum is 100 guests (above your 60 to 70) and the listing has no reviews yet; no hours, tortilla/salsa list or travel fee shown.

vendors.name: Taquizas Económicas Querétaro
vendors.price_text: Packages page: Básico Guisados, Tradicional Pastor (trompo de pastor, bistec, chorizo) and Parrillada Mixta (pastor, bistec, alambre, costilla) are each 'Precio desde*' $140 MXN; the asterisk is not explained, prices are 'estimados' for metro Querétaro, and the page does not say per person or per package (it says more guests means a lower price). vendors.serves: Querétaro metro (Juriquilla, Santa Rosa Jáuregui, Zibatá, El Refugio, Corregidora, El Pueblito, Balvanera, Centro Sur, Huimilpan, Milenio III), San Juan del Río and El Marqués; no extra charge within a 40 km radius, farther by consultation

Small deposit by transfer, balance on the day; its WhatsApp digits end in 4428158839, the call number on taquizasqueretaro.mx, so it may be the same group as Taquizas MX.

vendors.name: Taquizas en Querétaro VIP (taquizasenqueretarovip.com)

vendors.name: Taquizas en Querétaro El Trompo (taquizasenqueretaroelite.com)

vendors.serves: Querétaro, metro area and Corregidora ('cualquier zona de Querétaro y Corregidora'); no radius or travel fee shown
vendors.notes: Advertises 'servicio de tacos de trompo, bistec y chorizo para eventos en Querétaro' with carne al pastor on the wedding menu; claims 20 years of experience. Minimum is shown as 'desde 30 personas' in one place and 20 to 30 in the FAQ; no hours included or hacienda travel terms.

vendors.notes: Tequila producer (blanco, reposado, 'destilado', flavored liqueurs) whose staff invite guests to taste at the event; bottles can be bought alone and labels personalised with names and date. No bartender, bar or tasting details on the page.

vendors.name: Behind The Bar
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 7,000 per event (FAQ range 7,000-50,000; billed per event). Couples' package: 1 hour of welcome cocktails, carajillo station and open bar for the party, quoted by guest count, date and venue; packages have a 100-cocktail minimum (adjustable for a slight price increase).
vendors.serves: Listed in San Miguel de Allende (description says based in Irapuato); can travel, transport quoted by venue
vendors.notes: Fully equipped mobile bar with professional bartenders; open bar uses national and imported spirits. Lists 'Descorche' but BYO is not spelled out; no event time limit; mezcal and tequila offered; book 3-6 months ahead.

vendors.name: Cocktail Station SMA
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 250 (unit not stated; the page says billed per event). Couples' package includes furniture, glassware, service and spirits; minimum 50 guests; extra hours are priced per hour from the event quote; invoices add IVA.
vendors.serves: San Miguel de Allende and 'todo el Bajío'; travel expenses (viáticos) vary by zone
vendors.notes: Mobile bars, bartenders, open bar, gin and carajillo bars and a shot cart; lists 'Descorche' (BYO not spelled out). No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; 40 days' notice; own site https://www.cocktailstationsma.com.mx/ lists no prices.

vendors.name: Elixir Premium Drinks
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 250 (FAQ range 250-500; the page says billed per event but the unit is unclear). Couples' package: 200 welcome cocktails, 4 hours of open bar for 200 people and 100 free shots.
vendors.serves: San Miguel de Allende; page says it can travel, extra cost varies by place
vendors.notes: Bar and bartender service with mixology, micheladas and Aperol-spritz packages; no event time limit. Its consignment answer says the company keeps all the spirits once the hours are worked, so BYO is not described.

vendors.name: Barspoon
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 8,500 per event (FAQ range 8,500-40,000; billed per event). Couples' package: furniture, mixologists, glassware, cocktail supplies and ice, 'todo incluido e ilimitado'; package sized for 20 guests; extra hours depend on guest count.
vendors.serves: State of Querétaro, San Miguel de Allende and Estado de México; extra travel cost outside Querétaro city
vendors.notes: No consignment and BYO alcohol is not stated. No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; 10 days' notice to hold a tasting.

vendors.name: Garnitura Mixología
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 130 (FAQ range 130-160; billed 'Horas', so per guest vs per hour is not stated). 'Bebidas ilimitadas por tiempo determinado' with classic and signature cocktails by professional bartenders; minimum 60 guests per event.
vendors.serves: Querétaro city; freight surcharge outside the city; page says it can travel to other zones or states
vendors.notes: Lists both 'Consignación' (depends on event and hours) and 'Descorche' as services, so ask about BYO. No event time limit; tequila and mezcal listed; 10 days' notice.

vendors.name: Drink Inc.
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 150 (FAQ range 150-400; the page says billed per event but the unit is not stated next to the price). The minimum price is set for 50 guests; 50% at contract signing, the rest in agreed installments.
vendors.serves: Querétaro; page says it can travel with no extra travel cost
vendors.notes: Classic and original open-bar cocktails with bartenders; consignment only by prior negotiation (BYO not spelled out). No event time limit; tequila and mezcal listed; 30 days' notice.

vendors.name: Memory's Drink
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 220 (FAQ range 220-440; the page says billed per event but the unit is not stated). Couples' package: open bar of spirits for 10 continuous hours; minimum 100 guests; extra hours cost 5% of the open-bar total.
vendors.serves: Juriquilla / Querétaro; page says it can travel with no extra travel cost
vendors.notes: Lists 'Descorche' (no fee given) but no consignment. No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; 3 months' notice.

vendors.name: Barra Brava
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 8,000 (FAQ range 8,000-50,000; billed 'Horas', so the unit is unclear). Package 1: 3-hour mixology open bar; Package 2: welcome cocktails; minimum 50 guests; 10% deposit, balance 5 days before.
vendors.serves: San Luis Potosí; page says no extra travel cost within agreed distances outside the city, yet also answers 'No' to travelling to other zones or states
vendors.notes: Handles stand décor and premium ingredients; no event time limit; BYO alcohol not stated; mezcal and tequila listed.

vendors.name: Mayahuel Servicio de Bar
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 120 (FAQ range 120-100,000; billed 'Horas', unit unclear). Couples' package: welcome cocktail, guest toast and digestif; services include barra libre and a shot cart.
vendors.serves: San Luis Potosí; page says it can travel, no extra cost within its coverage area
vendors.notes: Under consignment it supplies glassware, a decorative bar and bar tools (and can supply liquors, digestifs and wine), so a bar-only arrangement may be possible. No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; at least 3 months' notice.

vendors.name: Lemon Bar Services
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 35 (unit not stated; no FAQ). The package lists a cocktail menu with or without alcohol, snack menu, glass table for the welcome cocktail, lit bar, shot cart, professional bartender staff and glassware.
vendors.serves: San Luis Potosí; travel not stated
vendors.notes: Rated 4.9 from 4 reviews; hours, minimums, BYO policy and mezcal are not stated.

vendors.name: Event Planner México
vendors.price_text: Bartender-only service is priced per shift (normally 5 hours); no peso amount is on the page ('rangos referenciales', confirmed by a quote within 24 hours). 50% deposit reserves equipment and supplies; extra hours depend on schedule, zone and bar complexity. Its separate open-bar packages with alcohol included are in the benchmarks.
vendors.serves: CDMX and nearby Estado de México; events in Estado de México, Cuernavaca or outside CDMX are quoted with travel
vendors.notes: Explicit BYO option ('Solo bartender: yo pongo alcohol, hielo, mezcladores y cristalería'); the page says many clients hire only the bartender to buy alcohol at a specific liquor store, and the physical bar is quoted separately. Staffing guide: 50-80 guests = 1 bartender + 1 barback; the team arrives 2-3 hours early.

vendors.name: Meseros.com.mx
vendors.price_text: Per person: Essential Mix MXN 210 (5 h) / 275 (7 h), Signature Bar 255 / 332, Ultra Premium 390 / 510; extra hour 32 / 39 / 60. Includes alcohol, cocktails, bartenders, crystal glassware, Coca-Cola-line mixers and garnishes; waiters not included; minimum 50 guests; 1 bartender per 50 guests.
vendors.serves: CDMX, metropolitan area and Cuernavaca, Morelos (own logistics)
vendors.notes: 'Solo Servicio' option: you supply the alcohol and they supply operations and glassware (price not on the page). Shots are not served.

vendors.name: Mixiu
vendors.price_text: Per person for 7 hours, excl. IVA, based on at least 80 guests: Plata 260, Oro 310, Pop 380, Platino 440, Diamante 560. Includes bartenders, bar setup and tiered spirits, wine, beer and digestifs; mixers and glassware rental are optional add-ons.
vendors.serves: CDMX and metro area; its bodas.com.mx page also names Querétaro, Estado de México, Morelos, Puebla, Hidalgo, Veracruz, Guerrero, Guanajuato and San Luis Potosí (extra cost outside CDMX)
vendors.notes: Rating 4.9 from 24 reviews is on https://www.bodas.com.mx/barra-libre/mixiu--e299767, which lists 'Descorche' but says 'Los insumos son propiedad de MIXIU', so BYO is not confirmed. No event time limit there; mezcal in the Pop, Platino and Diamante tiers and 'mesas de mezcal' offered.

vendors.name: IB International Bartenders
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 180 (FAQ range 180-500; billed 'Horas', so per guest vs per hour is unclear). Packages are 'con todo incluido' (contents not itemized); extra-hour cost depends on the package.
vendors.serves: CDMX; page says it can travel, with an extra charge only if the wedding is in another state
vendors.notes: Couples can supply the alcohol under a consignment arrangement and unused bottles are returned ('los novios puede poner el alcohol'). No event time limit; tequila and mezcal listed; 1 month's notice.

vendors.name: Chedrinks
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 9,000 (FAQ range 9,000-50,000; billed 'Horas', unit unclear). Couples' package is 'all inclusive': open bar, welcome cocktail and shots, with delivery and pickup of all material.
vendors.serves: CDMX; can also travel to Estado de México with no extra travel charge
vendors.notes: Lists 'Descorche' as a service (BYO not spelled out); no event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; contact 3-12 months ahead.

vendors.name: Ashnan Coctelería
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 95 (unit not stated; the page says billed per event). Package: mobile bars, bartenders, bar assistants, 6 hours of preparation, 10 cocktails, shot cart, welcome cocktails and carajillo bar; minimum 20 guests.
vendors.serves: Nezahualcóyotl / metro area; page says it can travel and quotes a budget for areas outside the metro area
vendors.notes: No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; BYO alcohol not stated; 30 days' notice.

vendors.name: Mezcal Nomás No Llores
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 2,500 per event (FAQ range 2,500-70,000; billed per event, extra hours charged per hour). 40% deposit; minimum 30 guests.
vendors.serves: CDMX; page says it can travel to other zones or states, cost depends on distance
vendors.notes: Mezcal-cocktail open bar with custom mezcal bottles and 'mezcalitas de autor'; services include tasting, bartender and 'Descorche' (BYO not spelled out). No event time limit; no consignment.

vendors.name: Mezcal Pasión Ardiente
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 250 (FAQ range 250-800; billed 'Horas', unit unclear). Couples' package 'todo lo necesario para la boda'; 50% deposit, 50% when the bar is set up; minimum order 1 case.
vendors.serves: Mostly Tlalpan; works across CDMX and Cuernavaca, and the FAQ says travel to the provinces costs extra
vendors.notes: Mezcal bar with tasting, pairing, consignment, bartender and 'Descorche' services; brands and tasting details are not stated. No event time limit; 1 month's notice.

vendors.name: Mezcal Bendito Remedio
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 1,000 (billed 'Horas'; FAQ range up to 900,000, unit not stated). Couples' package: 2 hours of tasting service of 4 mezcal types (joven, con gusano, reposado, añejo); mini-bottle favors; 50% deposit.
vendors.serves: CDMX (Cuajimalpa); page says it can travel, quoted separately
vendors.notes: Mezcal tasting for the welcome or the toast; lists 'Descorche' and a consignment contract with a bond. Has an event time limit (length not stated); 2 weeks' notice.

vendors.name: Shot Shot Drink
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 230 (FAQ range 230-580; billed 'Horas'; extra hours costed per hour per person). Couples' package: unlimited bar for the requested time, anti-hangover kits, personalised cups and a courtesy bottle of champagne.
vendors.serves: Taxco; page says it can travel to other zones or states, cost depends on distance
vendors.notes: The only bar vendor listed in Taxco on bodas.com.mx; lists 'Descorche' (BYO not spelled out). No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; book at least 3 months ahead.

vendors.name: Bartender AV
vendors.price_text: Page shows 'Precio desde $8' with no unit and no FAQ range, which cannot be a real price; ask for a quote. Listed travel surcharges: Cuernavaca to CDMX +MXN 2,500, Cuernavaca to Puebla +MXN 5,000; 50% deposit.
vendors.serves: Cuernavaca; page lists travel to CDMX and Puebla with surcharges
vendors.contact: WhatsApp 777 236 3509 (as listed on the bodas.com.mx page)
vendors.notes: Bartender team with author cocktails from organic and artisanal ingredients, a cocktail cart and carajillo bar; the couple opens the bar by making a cocktail they chose. BYO, hours, minimums and mezcal are not stated.

vendors.name: MoonLab
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 240 (FAQ range 240-550; the page says billed per event but the unit is unclear). Minimum 80 guests; extra hours quoted by package; 3% discount via bodas.com.mx.
vendors.serves: Cuernavaca / Morelos; outside Morelos 'favor de cotizar'
vendors.notes: Mixology bars, open bar, carajillo and Italian bars. No event time limit and no consignment; one review says the couple supplied their own alcohol, but the page does not state that as policy.

vendors.name: Chezmixology
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 280 (FAQ range 280-480; the page says billed per event but the unit is unclear). Each extra hour costs 10% of the total service; minimum '100 px'; travel fee 'Zona CDMX, Puebla' MXN 3,000.
vendors.serves: Cuernavaca; travels to CDMX and Puebla zones for a MXN 3,000 fee
vendors.notes: Packages include mixology, open bar of spirits, staff and all supplies; lists 'Descorche' (BYO not spelled out) and a consignment model in which it supplies the alcohol. No event time limit; tequila and mezcal listed; 3-6 months' notice.

vendors.name: DH Barra Libre - Vinos y Digestivos
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 139 (unit not stated; no FAQ range). Unlimited-alcohol bar service with custom packages and shots.
vendors.serves: Anywhere in Morelos; outside the state by prior agreement, extra charge by distance
vendors.notes: Team service focused on wines and digestifs; hours, minimums, BYO and mezcal are not stated.

vendors.name: Buenos Tragos
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 200 (FAQ range 200-50,000; billed per event; orders customizable 'desde una botella hasta la cantidad de cajas'). 50% advance deposit.
vendors.serves: Jonacatepec / Morelos; page answers 'No' to travelling to other zones or states, delivery cost depends on distance
vendors.notes: Artisanal mezcals (a photo names Monte Coyote) with tasting, mixology and bartender services. No event time limit; 1 week's notice.

vendors.name: Barra Aqualoca
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 35 (FAQ range 35-445; the page says billed per event but the unit is unclear). Couples' package 'todo incluido', customizable by brands and times. Consignment needs a MXN 12,000 minimum purchase with up to 25% of leftover alcohol returnable, and requires furniture and bartending staff to be contracted.
vendors.serves: Puebla; can travel to other zones if expenses are covered (cost by zone)
vendors.notes: Lists 'Descorche', consignment, bartender, furniture and tableware rental. No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; at least 10 days' notice.

vendors.name: 14 Onzas Barra Libre
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 5,500 per event (billed per event; the FAQ's top figure of 109,000,000 looks like an error). Package: 5 hours of unlimited bar (brandy, vodka, whiskey, rum, tequila) plus cocktails; extra hours cost 15% of the event total; minimum 25 guests.
vendors.serves: State of Puebla; can travel, cost depends on location
vendors.notes: No consignment and BYO alcohol is not stated. No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; at least 1 month's notice; pay in two installments.

vendors.name: Mezcal & Agave
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 7,000 per event (FAQ range 7,000-15,000; billed per event). 'Welcome Wedding Coctel' themed bar from 50 guests for 3, 4 or up to 5 hours; extra hours cost 15% of the invoice total; 10-50% deposit.
vendors.serves: Puebla and nearby towns; can travel with viáticos (tolls, lodging)
vendors.notes: Mezcal-led cocktail bar with a lit pallet bar, glassware, fire shot bar and mocktails; personal tasting available. No consignment; no event time limit; book up to 1 year ahead.

vendors.name: Marlop
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 1,500 (FAQ range 1,500-150,000; billed 'Horas', unit unclear). Packages are tailored; guided tastings and custom bars; event time limit 02:00, and overtime follows the labor-law cap of 3 extra hours a day (cost not stated).
vendors.serves: Puebla; can travel, cost by distance and quantities supplied
vendors.notes: Mezcal and tequila sourced from San Miguel Atlapulco (Puebla) and Los Altos de Jalisco, with tasting, mixology and bartender services; custom labels and souvenirs. At least 2 months' notice.

vendors.name: Mexican Spiritus Consulting Group
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 195 (the page says billed per event, unit unclear). The mixologist service is 4 hours with extra hours charged by staff required; free home delivery over MXN 999 in the Puebla-Cholula area; 50% deposit.
vendors.serves: Cholula / Puebla; page says it can travel to other zones or states (delivery cost by zone)
vendors.notes: Advisory and bar service built around 100% Mexican spirits (tequila, mezcal) with tasting, pairing, bartender and 'Descorche'. No event time limit; 1 week's notice.

vendors.name: Emagine
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 1,500 (FAQ range 1,500-50,000; billed per event; contracts can be 'por coctel' or 'por persona'). Extra hour: MXN 115 per person with alcohol, MXN 85 without. Couples' package: free tasting, 4 cocktail varieties, glassware and a lounge-style bar.
vendors.serves: Pachuca; page says it can travel, extra cost by event location
vendors.notes: Lists 'Descorche' as a service; no consignment. No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; 72 hours' notice.

vendors.name: Tu Momento
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 150 (FAQ range 150-900; billed per event, unit unclear). Unlimited open bar for the contracted time with classic and signature cocktails, lit bar and premium glassware (no plastic cups); the page says extra hours are charged as a full event.
vendors.serves: Pachuca; page says it can travel, extra cost depends on zone
vendors.notes: Themed gin-and-tonic, mezcal and artisanal tequila tables; the page shows an event time limit (length not stated). No consignment; BYO not stated.

vendors.name: Tuzito Bar
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 5,000 (FAQ range 5,000-30,000; billed 'Horas'; each extra hour MXN 1,500). Couples' package: private service, 4-5 drinks of your choice, mobile bar.
vendors.serves: Tizayuca, Hidalgo; page says it can travel to other zones or states, with a freight charge
vendors.notes: Mobile cocktail and bartender service; lists 'Descorche' (no fee or BYO policy given). No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; book up to 1 month ahead.

vendors.name: Ikbar Móvil
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 85 (FAQ range 85-500; billed 'Horas', unit unclear). Service from 1 hour; minimum 20 guests.
vendors.serves: Puebla; no travel fee in Puebla city, Atlixco, Cholula and nearby; can serve other zones and states
vendors.notes: Packages include the bar, supplies, glassware, standard spirits, ice and trained staff; lists 'Descorche' (no fee or policy given) and no consignment. No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed.

vendors.name: Tahiti Mixology Bar Móvil
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 6,500 (unit not stated on bodas.com.mx). Most-hired: 1-hour welcome mixology bar, 3- or 5-hour reception bar, 8-hour open bar. Its own site shows no package prices but lists tastings at MXN 1,500 (10 cocktails) and MXN 2,000 (15 cocktails).
vendors.serves: Any point in Mérida; page says it travels outside Mérida with a cost by distance (Valladolid not named)
vendors.notes: Founded 2016; own site https://tahitimixology.com/en mentions a 'Tequila and Mezcal station' and an open bar with national mixers, and lugaresparaeventos.mx lists its coverage as 'Estatal' (statewide). BYO alcohol not stated.

vendors.name: Zawer Mixology
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 6,000 (FAQ range 6,000-500,000; billed 'Horas', unit unclear). Minimum 200 cocktails; maximum 500 guests; extra hours follow a 'tabulador' using distance, guest count and supplies; 50% at quote confirmation, 50% before the event.
vendors.serves: Mérida; travel charge by distance, same for other states (Valladolid not named)
vendors.notes: Works inside the bar the couple already set up so the theme and furniture are kept; lists 'Descorche' (no fee or BYO policy given) and no consignment. No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed.

vendors.name: Barras Libres Riviera Maya
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 199 (FAQ range 199-2,000; billed 'Horas', unit unclear). Couples' package: whisky, rum, gin, vodka, tequila, mezcal, digestifs, wine and beer for 8 hours; extra hours about 5-10%.
vendors.serves: Mérida address; says the same prices apply across Quintana Roo with no extra travel charge; can travel to other zones or states (Valladolid not named)
vendors.notes: 'Full Service' brings bar, back-bar, glassware, ice, mixers and bartenders; a 'Liquor Supply' option suits venues that already have a bar and staff. Lists 'Descorche' with no fee; no event time limit.

vendors.name: YucaDrinks
vendors.price_text: No price shown; the page lists cocktails, non-alcoholic drinks and professional staff.
vendors.serves: Calotmul, Yucatán; service area not stated (Valladolid not named)
vendors.notes: The only bar vendor in the Yucatán listing based outside Mérida; claims 15+ years serving events. Hours, BYO and mezcal are not stated.

vendors.name: Barra Oaxaca
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 220 (FAQ range 220-500; the page says billed per event but the unit is unclear). Couples' package is a tasting to choose the couple's favorite cocktails; extra hours are proportional to total service hours; travel fee applies beyond 10 km from Oaxaca de Juárez; 5% bodas.com.mx discount.
vendors.serves: Oaxaca de Juárez (travel fee beyond 10 km); page says it can travel to other zones or states
vendors.notes: Mezcal tastings at weddings, mixology and show bartending with premium glassware; lists 'Descorche' and 'Consignación' (it supplies the alcohol), so BYO is unconfirmed. No event time limit; one couple rehired it for their civil ceremony.

vendors.name: KAOS Drinks
vendors.price_text: '3 horas de coctelería en muro drink ring personalizado' MXN 120 per person; 60 L draft beer wall (for 150 guests) with cups and base MXN 8,200; 'Descorche' MXN 100 per person (6 hr); extra hours +30-50% prorated; a 100-guest minimum applies to 'algún servicio' (which one is not stated).
vendors.serves: Oaxaca city (no travel charge); description also names Puerto Escondido, Huatulco and nearby destinations (charge by distance), though its FAQ answers 'No' to travelling to other zones or states, so confirm
vendors.notes: One of the few pages that prices corkage ('descorche'), so it may pour your own bottles; premium mobile bars with signature cocktails, long drinks and a coffee bar. No event time limit; mezcal and tequila listed; 1 month's notice.

vendors.name: Bixhooze - Barras Móviles y Coctelería Profesional
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 5,000 per event (billed per event; FAQ range 5,000-1,000,000). Couples' package: liquor, barman and helpers, furniture, canapés and a cheese table.
vendors.serves: Oaxaca city and 'otros rincones del estado'; transport fee ('arrastre') outside the center; page says it can travel to other zones or states
vendors.notes: Lists 'Descorche' and 'Consignación' (percentages depend on the purchase). No event time limit and no minimum order; mezcal and tequila listed.

vendors.name: Movimart
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 80 (unit not stated; no FAQ range); listed for 50 to 2,000 guests.
vendors.serves: Oaxaca; travel outside the city not stated
vendors.notes: Team of helpers, bartender and advisers with 400+ cocktails (with and without alcohol), lit bars and a wine list; event time limit 06:00, so it suits a very late party. BYO alcohol not stated; mezcal not mentioned.

vendors.name: Miscelánea Mezcalera
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 5,000 per event (FAQ range 5,000-100,000; billed per event). Services: tasting, delivery, mixology, cocktail bar, bulk mezcal for the event, souvenir-bottle design; consignment terms agreed on contact; a minimum order applies (amount not stated).
vendors.serves: Oaxaca; page says it can travel at an extra cost (amount not stated)
vendors.notes: Mezcals described: Espadín, Tobalá and Arroqueño, clay-pot distilled at 48%; couples choose the variety. No event time limit; contact 3 weeks ahead.

vendors.name: Saka Casa Mezcalera
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 10 (FAQ range 10-100,000; billed per event, unit unclear). Consignment: 'solo paga lo que consumen'; custom bottles and shot glasses; travel cost depends on purchase volume.
vendors.serves: Oaxaca; page says it can travel to other zones or states
vendors.notes: Mezcales, curados and cremas with tasting, pairing, mixology and bartender services. No event time limit and no minimum order; at least 15 days' notice.

vendors.name: Comercializadora Otes
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 75 (FAQ range 75-1,500; billed per event and 'vende por producto no por hora'). Minimum order 2 cases; free delivery to the event in Oaxaca; 50% deposit, 50% fifteen days before.
vendors.serves: Oaxaca (no travel cost inside Oaxaca); page says it can travel to other zones or states
vendors.notes: A mezcal supplier rather than a bartending service: artisanal and ancestral mezcals (Tobalá, Tepextate, Coyote, Espadín), custom bottling and labels, rental or sale of mezcal cups. No consignment; book 2 months to 1 year ahead.

vendors.name: Tradición Chagoya - Mezcales
vendors.price_text: Page shows 'Precio desde $1' and an FAQ range of 1-25, which looks like a placeholder; ask for a quote.
vendors.serves: Oaxaca; service area not stated
vendors.notes: Five-generation family mezcal producer (Donají, Los Cuerudos, Tehuana) offering tasting, pairing, mixology and bartending; events have an hour limit of 01:00. Also lists a Huatulco coffee liqueur and margarita.

vendors.name: Cordón Cerrado
vendors.price_text: Desde MXN 50 (unit not stated; no FAQ range).
vendors.serves: Oaxaca; travel not stated
vendors.notes: Mezcal company offering personalised keepsake bottles, 30 ml shots and a hire-a-bar option; agaves named include espadín, cuish, tobalá, tepeztate and madrecuish. A reviewer says it pairs mezcals to the menu.

vendors.name: Mezcal Nucano
vendors.price_text: No price shown; listed for 10 to 1,000 guests.
vendors.serves: Orders served from Oaxaca city to any state of Mexico by parcel
vendors.notes: Supplier only (Añejo Gran Reserva, Joven and Reposado, produced in San Dionisio Ocotepec); no bartending, bar or tasting service is described.

vendors.name: Meseros y Bartender Sánchez
